parameters.name: BH
parameters.description: The ratio of the height of the subtitle area to the image height. Valid values: 0 to 1.

parameters.name: BW
parameters.description: The ratio of the width of the subtitle area to the image width. Valid values: 0 to 1.

parameters.name: BX
parameters.description: The ratio of the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the subtitle area to the image width. Valid values: 0 to 1.

parameters.name: BY
parameters.description: The ratio of the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the subtitle area to the image height. Valid values: 0 to 1.

parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
